title: Answer: consciousness is the presence of a world, a graded cluster of constraints

statements.text: Consciousness at its minimum is the presence of a world, a transparent global model of reality within a window of presence, enriched by further constraints into subjective experience from a first-person perspective. It has no set of necessary and sufficient conditions: it is a graded construct, membership comes in degrees, and its simplest form may be the experience of tonic alertness.

sources.quote: Phenomenologically, minimal consciousness is described as the presence of a world.
it is a heterogeneous and graded construct, and membership comes in degrees
